interface.shortDescription: AI UGC videos of your products
interface.longDescription:
Say It Again makes AI UGC videos, product videos and image ads for online stores. Connected to ChatGPT, it makes them with you in a conversation: give it a product link, and a generated presenter films themselves with your product and says why, in your product page's own words.

What it does:
- Reads a product from its link: its name, description, benefits and photos.
- Writes 3 scripts for a video of it, for you to read before anything is made. Each script says what the presenter does, the scene, and each shot's line.
- Says how many credits a video takes, and whether your balance covers it.
- Makes the video for the credits it said, and says when it is ready, with a link to download it that works for an hour.
- Makes a product video: your product alone on camera, with a voiceover, a voiceover over music, or music alone.
- Makes a set of 3 or 6 image ads of a product, each a picture with its own headline, second line and button.
- Builds a video from an ad you choose, keeping its structure or only its pacing.
- Makes a presenter from your description, with the voice you choose.
- After a video is made, changes it, makes it longer, makes it in another language or gives it other sizes, and makes a finished product video again with the current model when its page offers it.
- Lists your videos and the presenters you can choose from.

Who it is for: people who run an online store and use Say It Again to make video ads of their products.

Limits:
- It works with your Say It Again account, connected by the team's owner.
- Making, changing, lengthening or translating a video, remaking a product video, and making image ads spend your team's credits, the same number as in the app, and a video or a set that fails gives them back. Every other tool spends none. ChatGPT sends the number of credits with each of these, and a different number is refused.
- A video takes a few minutes, and nothing tells you when it is ready: ask, and ChatGPT checks.
- It cannot buy credits, change a plan, or publish or post a video anywhere.
- The presenter is generated, never a real customer. The scripts we write are checked against your product page. Lines you give it are said as written.

AI UGC videos, product videos and image ads made by Say It Again carry Content Credentials. Each file says it was generated, and which tool made it. Say It Again is a conformant Generator Product on the C2PA™ Conforming Products List.
